notes: Route: WordPress REST API /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?after=2026-09-25T00:00:00&before=2026-10-26T00:00:00&per_page=100&page=N (paginate until short page). Probes: robots.txt 200, permissive (only /?s=, /search/, /wp-admin/ disallowed; advertises /sitemap_index.xml). sitemap_index.xml 200 (Yoast index): post-sitemap.xml lastmod 2026-10-25, the rest 2020-era. Fetched post-sitemap.xml (200, 1001 urls): unusable for dates because <lastmod> is edit time (only 1 of 1001 entries had a 2026 lastmod; rest are re-edited 2020 articles) and slugs carry no date, so the API was the route. API 200, returns link + date (site-local publish time, +01:00). Verified vs 4 sample article pages (all 200, 5200-6500 chars of visible text, JSON-LD datePublished = same moment in UTC, same calendar date as listed). Result: 2085 unique URLs, 31/31 days in window, 09-30=90, 10-10=38, 10-20=72, min day 29. ~55 s wall time at polite_fetch 2 req/s. No 429s hit; script backs off 30 s and retries once if it does. Script idempotent, rewrites TSV each run.
